nativeEvidence.distribution: five locally packed npm tarballs installed into a fresh npm prefix
nativeEvidence.isolation: dedicated uid inside a loopback-only Linux network namespace; no paid model or Cloud calls
nativeEvidence.providerProtocol: documented first-party muse-code/models catalog and responses SSE protocol
checks: repeated setup preserves existing approval without duplicates
absolute Node path and one unique relative source file per hook
normal hooks use saved private credentials despite cleared environment
two real prompts share session identity and have separate traces
request and tool children use their turn root as parent
echo provider is not represented as an LLM call
cumulative counters are differenced only across contiguous first-attempt successes
uninstall leaves the unrelated fixture plugin installed

openGates: Full-content enrichment needs a bounded versioned retained-session reader: real hook transcript_path is null and model hooks expose previews, not full requests/responses.
Verified child ancestry needs retained-session linkage: real SubagentStart names the child session itself and supplies no parent session/turn anchor. Do not infer ancestry from event arrival order.
Stop is a request-to-stop hook that another hook can veto. Terminal confirmation, continuation after a veto, interruption, retry and real compaction lifecycle qualification remain open.
Per-project routing and policy persistence are implemented but need native multi-project and privacy-ceiling scenarios beyond the happy path.
Full Astro/catalog/link validation and real Future AGI trace-view screenshots/GIF have not been completed.
The integration owner must regenerate the monorepo lockfile and wire release inventory only after qualification; npm publication and public clean-install verification remain separate gates.
